infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: MemTool uses the microphone for the optional 'Speak a memory' capture mode. Audio is transcribed on-device and never uploaded.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: MemTool uses Apple's on-device Speech framework to turn your 'Speak a memory' recordings into editable text. Audio stays on your device and is never uploaded.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: MemTool can read recent calendar events to add gentle context to your Daily Recap (e.g. 'You had 3 meetings today'). Events stay on-device.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: MemTool can read recent calendar events to add gentle context to your Daily Recap (e.g. 'You had 3 meetings today'). Events stay on-device.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: MemTool uses the camera so you can attach a photo to a memory. Attached photos are uploaded to your MemTool account for backup and display.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: MemTool lets you choose photos from your library to attach to memories. Selected photos are uploaded to your MemTool account for backup and display.
